hero.description: You've probably got hundreds of good shots sitting in a folder somewhere. Milestis turns them into a page you can flip through, share, and actually be proud of — built in minutes, no design tools required.
hero.imageAlt: An open interactive photo book page

stats.label: Ways to lay out your photos

manifesto.quote: Memory is the only paradise from which we cannot be driven away.
manifesto.author: Jean Paul

steps.title: Pick a layout
steps.description: Every template already has good spacing and structure built in, so the hard part is done before you even start.

steps.title: Add your photos
steps.description: Drop in the shots you love. Milestis handles the cropping and placement automatically.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description: Swap the colors, add captions, reorder pages — however far you push it, the layout keeps its shape.

steps.title: Publish and share
steps.description: You get one link you can send to anyone. No app to install, no account needed to view it.

items.title: Layouts that hold up
items.description: Rearrange your photos as much as you like — the composition stays clean no matter what you throw at it.

items.title: Light and depth
items.description: Soft shadows and parallax make each page feel like real space instead of a flat image.

items.title: Color palettes
items.description: Choose from dozens of ready-made palettes, or pull one straight from a photo already in your book.

items.title: Pages that respond
items.description: Scroll or tap and the page reacts, so reading feels closer to turning real pages.

items.title: One link to share
items.description: Anyone can open your book — no login, no app, no waiting.

items.title: Big days worth reliving
items.description: A wedding, a trip, a birthday — give it a book your guests will actually open again, instead of scrolling past once.

items.title: A portfolio in minutes
items.description: Freelancers and creators use Milestis to put a portfolio together fast, and update it just as easily.

items.title: Something better than a folder
items.description: Studios hand clients a finished, branded gallery instead of a drive full of raw files.
